compatibility: data remains the existing active shift or null; START, original START keys, END and stored receipts are unchanged. Never synthesize a shift to expose capability.
authorization: Existing authentication, active account, MiniAppWorkShiftService::PERMISSIONS and stable current login family. WarehouseContext verifies the confirmed active warehouse and current warehouse ACL.

mode.precedence: DRAINING wins when both runtime flags are true.
mode.tracked_family: True if ANY persisted tracked shift belongs to this actor and stable login family, including ended shifts.
mode.owner_fence_required: ENABLED or an already tracked family, including when both flags are disabled.
mode.disabled_legacy: This capability does not authorize legacy START or fallback. Existing legacy writer behavior is not modified or silently upgraded.

admission.new_tracked_start_supported: True only for current=null, mode=ENABLED and confirmed READY warehouse in current rights.
admission.new_shift_tracking_contract: p14-shift-v1 only when new_tracked_start_supported=true; otherwise null.

freshness.observed_at: Current RFC3339 UTC Z observation, not a lease, signed admission token or immutable snapshot.
freshness.race: Mode/rights/warehouse can change after GET. START still revalidates under its existing transaction/locks; a previous true is not authorization.

app_rules: Bind response/generation to exact actor, stable family and confirmed warehouse.
Current=null does not resolve an original START or END UNKNOWN. Keep original key/body/version and owner reconcile.
Do not automatically START from a capability read or END-as-logout.
Missing/unsupported metadata is unavailable, not permission to downgrade a tracked family to legacy.
True does not prove local no-work/CLEAN or complete owner coverage.
